flags.why: The gloss substitutes unscrupulous ambition for attaining wealth or status through luck rather than ability ([dictionary](https://v2.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/H%C3%A3nh_ti%E1%BA%BFn)).
flags.fix: having risen suddenly to wealth or high status through luck rather than merit

flags.why: This noun denotes a twig structure provided for silkworms to spin cocoons, rather than a bird's nest ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=b%E1%BB%A7a)).
flags.fix: a structure of branching twigs on which silkworms spin cocoons

flags.why: The bird-building example uses bủa for an ordinary nest, which is not this meaning ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=b%E1%BB%A7a)).
flags.fix: Người nuôi tằm ghép những cành cây nhỏ thành bủa cho tằm làm kén. = The silkworm farmer assembles small branches into a structure for the silkworms to spin cocoons on.

flags.why: The common meaning describing an underbite is missing, so learners could mistakenly understand a young person described as móm to be toothless.
flags.fix: adj | having an underbite (the lower teeth or jaw project beyond the upper ones)

flags.why: Đàn does not specify a guitar, but the translation introduces one.
flags.fix: Dad sits by the porch plucking a stringed instrument.

flags.why: The Vietnamese does not specify whether the engine runs on petrol or diesel.
flags.fix: He uses an engine to pump water into the field.
